First time at a Fukuoka yatai?
These are the city's open-air food stalls.
Most seat about 10 people at most.
Here are 3 first-timer mistakes, and the fix 👇

👀 Full guide 👉 https://japanbystation.com/fukuoka-where-to-stay-first-trip

❌ Mistake 1: bringing your suitcase
There's nowhere to put luggage.
Drop it at your hotel or a coin locker first.

❌ Mistake 2: sitting without ordering
The basic rule: one order per person.
Stalls live on quick turnover.
So eat, pay, and try a second stall.

❌ Mistake 3: coming as a big group
Two or three people slip in easily.
Six means waiting, or splitting up.

✅ The fix
Go in a small group from about 6 pm.
Start at the river stalls in Nakasu,
then hop to the next one.
Or try Nagahama, by the fish market.
Nagahama no Hiroshi often starts the night
with a ¥900 pork-wrapped lettuce roll.

🌧️ Honest warning
On stormy nights, some stalls don't open.
If yatai are the reason for your trip,
give yourself two evenings.
